title: Fushimi Inari in the morning · Kiyomizu & the Higashiyama slopes · Gion · Nishiki · Kyoto shopping · Pontocho lanterns · Kiyamachi night

stops.name: Kujō House
stops.plan: Out at 06:20 with ICOCA/Suica topped up and passports; konbini coffee and onigiri on the way.
stops.transport: Hanshin to Nishikujō, JR Loop line → Osaka, JR Kyoto line special rapid → Kyoto, JR Nara line → Inari, about 1 h 55 min door to door

stops.name: Fushimi Inari Taisha
stops.plan: Through the Senbon torii ahead of the tour groups and up to the Yotsutsuji viewpoint over Kyoto (about 45 min up), then back down.
stops.transport: Taxi, 2 cars, 21 min to the Kiyomizu-dera approach (about ¥2,500 per car); the train plus the uphill walk takes over an hour

stops.name: Kiyomizu-dera & Sannenzaka/Ninenzaka
stops.plan: The wooden stage view first, then walk down Sannenzaka and Ninenzaka past the Yasaka pagoda to Yasaka Shrine.
stops.transport: Walk from Yasaka Shrine into Gion, 5 min

stops.name: Gion: Hanamikoji & Shirakawa
stops.plan: Stroll Hanamikoji's teahouse lane and the willow-lined Shirakawa canal (no photos on the private side lanes), then cross the Shijo bridge.
stops.transport: Walk west over the Kamo river on Shijo-dori to Nishiki, 16 min

stops.name: Nishiki Market
stops.plan: Graze lunch at whichever stalls are open (tamagoyaki, tako tamago, soy-milk donuts). It's a Wednesday and many shops close, so if it's thin, finish lunch in the Shinkyogoku arcade next door.

stops.name: Shinkyogoku & Teramachi arcades + Nintendo KYOTO
stops.plan: Teramachi vintage and SPINNS, souvenirs along Shinkyogoku, then Nintendo KYOTO on 7F of Takashimaya at the Shijo-Kawaramachi crossing.

stops.name: Pontocho alley
stops.plan: Walk the lantern-lit stone lane as it gets dark and have one drink by the Kamo river (expect a seat charge).
stops.transport: Walk one block west to Kiyamachi, 7 min

stops.name: Kiyamachi-dori bars
stops.plan: Izakaya dinner for 8 with nomihodai along the canal, then standing bars and cheap chain bars between Shijo and Sanjo.
stops.transport: Walk along Kiyamachi to Kitsune, 1 min

stops.name: Kitsune Kyoto
stops.plan: A short early-session dance on the foreigner ticket (passports), then out at 22:40 sharp for the 23:00 train; if you miss it, taxi home from Kitahama.
stops.price: About US$3 pp foreigner entry, booked online
stops.transport: Walk to Sanjo, Keihan limited express 23:00 → Kitahama, Metro Sakaisuji line → Sakaisuji-Hommachi, Chuo line → Kujō, about 95 min door to door
